explanation: The family first appeared in 1987, in short cartoons on The Tracey Ullman Show. The series keeps Springfield's US state a running mystery.

claims.text: The Simpsons is set in the fictional town of Springfield.
Shelbyville is Springfield's rival town in the show, Quahog is the setting of Family Guy, and South Park is the town of its own series.
The Simpsons family first appeared in 1987, in short cartoons on The Tracey Ullman Show.
The series deliberately never says which US state Springfield is in.
